clauses.text: 1.1 These guidelines govern the acceptance, pricing referral and binding of Commercial Property risks written on form MM-CP-0010.
clauses.full_text: 1.1 These guidelines govern the acceptance, pricing referral and binding of Commercial Property risks written on form MM-CP-0010.

clauses.text: 1.2 Underwriters must apply these guidelines together with Rate Manual MM-RM-CP-2025 and the state filings listed above.
clauses.full_text: 1.2 Underwriters must apply these guidelines together with Rate Manual MM-RM-CP-2025 and the state filings listed above.

clauses.text: 1.3 Any exception to these guidelines requires written approval from an Underwriting Manager and must be documented in the underwriting file.
clauses.full_text: 1.3 Any exception to these guidelines requires written approval from an Underwriting Manager and must be documented in the underwriting file.

clauses.text: 2.1 Eligible Risks. A risk is eligible if all of the following are true: (a) construction class is CC1 through CC6; (b) Public Protection Class is PC1 through PC8; (c) the building is not vacant and has not been vacant for more than 60 consecutive days in the prior 12 months; (d) Total Insured Value (TIV) does not exceed $25,000,000 per location; (e) the class code is not listed as Prohibited in Section 2.3.
clauses.full_text: 2.1 Eligible Risks. A risk is eligible if all of the following are true: (a) construction class is CC1 through CC6; (b) Public Protection Class is PC1 through PC8; (c) the building is not vacant and has not been vacant for more than 60 consecutive days in the prior 12 months; (d) Total Insured Value (TIV) does not exceed $25,000,000 per location; (e) the class code is not listed as Prohibited in Section 2.3.

clauses.text: 2.2 Referral Risks. The following risks may be written only with Underwriting Manager approval: Protection Class PC9 or PC10; buildings over 50 years old without updated electrical, plumbing, heating and roof within the last 25 years; class code 0921 (Vacant Buildings); any location in FEMA flood zone A, AE, V or VE that does not carry MM-CP-E101.
clauses.full_text: 2.2 Referral Risks. The following risks may be written only with Underwriting Manager approval: Protection Class PC9 or PC10; buildings over 50 years old without updated electrical, plumbing, heating and roof within the last 25 years; class code 0921 (Vacant Buildings); any location in FEMA flood zone A, AE, V or VE that does not carry MM-CP-E101.

clauses.text: 2.3 Prohibited Risks. Underwriters must not quote or bind any risk with class code 0511, any risk with unresolved open fire code violations, or any risk located in a state where form MM-CP-0010 is not approved (currently NY, pending Filing MM-NY-2025-0211).
clauses.full_text: 2.3 Prohibited Risks. Underwriters must not quote or bind any risk with class code 0511, any risk with unresolved open fire code violations, or any risk located in a state where form MM-CP-0010 is not approved (currently NY, pending Filing MM-NY-2025-0211).

clauses.text: 3.1 An underwriter must not bind a risk that exceeds his or her authority level.
clauses.full_text: 3.1 An underwriter must not bind a risk that exceeds his or her authority level.

clauses.text: 3.2 Where a risk exceeds the authority of the assigned underwriter, the file must be referred before a quote is released.
clauses.full_text: 3.2 Where a risk exceeds the authority of the assigned underwriter, the file must be referred before a quote is released.

rows: Chief Underwriting Officer and facultative reinsurance

clauses.text: 4.1 Every policy must include the base coverage form MM-CP-0010 and the causes of loss form MM-CP-1030 in the edition approved in the state of the risk.
clauses.full_text: 4.1 Every policy must include the base coverage form MM-CP-0010 and the causes of loss form MM-CP-1030 in the edition approved in the state of the risk.

clauses.text: 4.2 Florida policies must include MM-CP-FL-01 Florida Amendatory Endorsement.
clauses.full_text: 4.2 Florida policies must include MM-CP-FL-01 Florida Amendatory Endorsement.

clauses.text: 4.3 MM-CP-E310 Windstorm or Hail Percentage Deductible is mandatory for all locations in Florida Tier 1 coastal counties and in Texas rating territory TX-T01; a 5% deductible is required within one mile of the coast and 2% elsewhere in those territories.
clauses.full_text: 4.3 MM-CP-E310 Windstorm or Hail Percentage Deductible is mandatory for all locations in Florida Tier 1 coastal counties and in Texas rating territory TX-T01; a 5% deductible is required within one mile of the coast and 2% elsewhere in those territories.

clauses.text: 4.4 Any scheduled location in FEMA flood zone A, AE, V or VE must carry MM-CP-E101 Flood Coverage Endorsement, or the insured must sign a Flood Exclusion Acknowledgment form before binding.
clauses.full_text: 4.4 Any scheduled location in FEMA flood zone A, AE, V or VE must carry MM-CP-E101 Flood Coverage Endorsement, or the insured must sign a Flood Exclusion Acknowledgment form before binding.

clauses.text: 4.5 MM-CP-E415 Protective Safeguards is required when the rate manual applies a sprinkler credit (factor SPR-1) or a central station alarm credit (factor ALM-1).
clauses.full_text: 4.5 MM-CP-E415 Protective Safeguards is required when the rate manual applies a sprinkler credit (factor SPR-1) or a central station alarm credit (factor ALM-1).

clauses.text: 4.6 Endorsements may be attached only in states where the State Filing shows the status Approved.
clauses.full_text: 4.6 Endorsements may be attached only in states where the State Filing shows the status Approved.

clauses.text: 5.1 Before releasing a quote the underwriter must verify: eligibility under Section 2; that the premium was developed from Rate Manual MM-RM-CP-2025; and that all required endorsements under Section 4 are included.
clauses.full_text: 5.1 Before releasing a quote the underwriter must verify: eligibility under Section 2; that the premium was developed from Rate Manual MM-RM-CP-2025; and that all required endorsements under Section 4 are included.

clauses.text: 5.2 Before binding, the underwriter must verify that every form edition on the policy matches the edition approved in the applicable State Filing.
clauses.full_text: 5.2 Before binding, the underwriter must verify that every form edition on the policy matches the edition approved in the applicable State Filing.

clauses.text: 5.3 The underwriting file must document the flood zone determination for every scheduled location.
clauses.full_text: 5.3 The underwriting file must document the flood zone determination for every scheduled location.

clauses.text: 5.4 Inspections are required within 60 days of binding for any location with TIV above $2,000,000 or Protection Class PC7 or higher.
clauses.full_text: 5.4 Inspections are required within 60 days of binding for any location with TIV above $2,000,000 or Protection Class PC7 or higher.

clauses.text: 6.1 At renewal the underwriter must confirm that form editions remain current and that no State Filing has withdrawn a form in use.
clauses.full_text: 6.1 At renewal the underwriter must confirm that form editions remain current and that no State Filing has withdrawn a form in use.

clauses.text: 6.3 Where a newer edition of a form has been approved, the newer edition must be attached at renewal.
clauses.full_text: 6.3 Where a newer edition of a form has been approved, the newer edition must be attached at renewal.
